lastCompletedStory.title: Arm the recycle marker via cam journal append --cycle-close

nextStoryContext: ParsedJournalArgs now has `cycleClose: boolean` on the append member. dispatchJournal checks parsed.cycleClose after the durable writes (CAM_JOURNAL_APPENDED + recordFn); if handoff absent: printError + return 3; if handoff present: calls armRecycleMarkerFn (default: writeFileSync .claude/ORCH_RECYCLE_MARKER). Injectable deps `handoffExistsFn` and `armRecycleMarkerFn` added to JournalDispatchDeps. CAM_ORCH_HANDOFF_DUE=true is emitted on the success path (both cycle-close and non-cycle-close). Production import: ORCH_RECYCLE_MARKER from src/tmux/session.ts; existsSync, mkdirSync from node:fs. The two toEqual assertions at test lines 315/319 were updated to include cycleClose: false; the pinned tests at :357/:448 are unchanged. US-003 should implement the orch-recycle-watch module that detects the marker, resolves the orchestrator PID, and sends SIGTERM.
